Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
Today, surrender thy will unto Him. Trust not in thy logic, but in His eternal wisdom.
The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
He is thy Provider. Rest in the assurance that thy needs are known to the Father.
Have not I commanded thee? Be strong and of a good courage; be not afraid, neither be thou dismayed: for the LORD thy God is with thee whithersoever thou goest.
Fear is but a shadow. Walk boldly this day, for the Almighty attendeth thy steps.
I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me.
Thine own strength shall fail, but His power in thee is limitless. Labour with joy.
But seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his righteousness; and all these things shall be added unto you.
Put first the things of eternity. Let thy priorities reflect thy devotion to the King.
Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.
In a world of darkness, His Word is thy sure guide. Meditate upon it this hour.
Be still, and know that I am God.
Cease thy strivings. In the quietness of thy spirit, behold the glory of thy Maker.
And whatsoever ye do, do it heartily, as to the Lord, and not unto men.
Let thy daily tasks be an altar of worship. Excellence is a fruit of faithfulness.
For the joy of the LORD is your strength.
Though trials come, let His joy be thy fortress. It is the fuel for thy journey.
Let all your things be done with charity.
Let love be the foundation of thy disciplines and thy dealings with others today.
Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.
Art thou weary? Cast thy burdens upon Him. His yoke is easy and His rest is deep.
For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
Walk not in timidity, but in the authority of the Spirit. Thy mind is stayed on Him.
In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
A thankful heart is a magnet for miracles. Find grace in all thy circumstances.
But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles.
Wait with patience. He is preparing thee for higher flights and greater endurance.
Jesus saith unto him, I am the way, the truth, and the life.
Follow the Master. He is the only Path that leadeth to the Father\'s heart.
Casting all your care upon him; for he careth for you.
Thou art not alone in thy worries. He who numbereth the hairs of thy head careth for thee.
The LORD is nigh unto all them that call upon him, to all that call upon him in truth.
Speak to thy King. He is closer than thy very breath when thou seekest Him in sincerity.
Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
Ask for a fresh cleansing. Let His holiness permeate thy thoughts and desires this day.
Let your light so shine before men, that they may see your good works, and glorify your Father which is in heaven.
Thy life is a testimony. Let thy deeds be a reflection of the Light of the World.
For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.
Trust in His providence. Thy future is secure in the hands of the Great Architect.
It is of the LORD\'s mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning.
Behold the dawn of His mercy. Every morning is a fresh opportunity to walk in His grace.
My grace is sufficient for thee: for my strength is made perfect in weakness.
Glory in thy limitations, for they are the vessels through which His power is revealed.
And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind.
Let not the world mould thee. Be changed by the power of the Word and the Spirit.
The name of the LORD is a strong tower: the righteous runneth into it, and is safe.
When the storms of life arise, call upon His Name. He is thy Fortress and thy Shield.
Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ.
He is the Author and the Finisher. Trust Him to complete the tapestry of thy life.
Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: not as the world giveth, give I unto you.
Accept His supernatural quietness. Let not thy heart be troubled, nor let it be afraid.
Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established.
Hand over thy plans to Him this morning. He shall direct thy paths and steady thy mind.
In every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God.
Turn thy cares into prayers. Gratitude in the midst of asking brings profound peace.
The LORD shall fight for you, and ye shall hold your peace.
Cease thy striving. The battle is not thine, but the Lord\'s. Trust in His sovereign hand today.
For we walk by faith, not by sight.
Look beyond the visible. Let the eye of thy spirit be fixed upon the eternal promises of God.
And let us not be weary in well doing: for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not.
Faint not in thy disciplines. The harvest of righteousness is certain for the steadfast soul.
But as for me and my house, we will serve the LORD.
Dedicate thy home anew to the Master. Let thy family be a sanctuary of His presence.
A friend loveth at all times, and a brother is born for adversity.
Be a vessel of Christ\'s love to thy brethren. Loyalty is a hallmark of the redeemed.
He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name\'s sake.
Allow the Good Shepherd to heal thy spirit and guide thy steps toward holiness.
I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith.
Press on toward the mark. Thy perseverance today buildeth a legacy for eternity.
The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear?
When darkness seeketh to overwhelm thee, remember the Light of the King. Thou art safe.
Commit thy way unto the Lord; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
Cast thy future upon His shoulders. His timing is perfect, and His hand is steady.
He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
Find thy refuge in prayer. The shadow of the Almighty is thy sure protection from all harm.
Behold, I stand at the door, and knock: if any man hear my voice, and open the door, I will come in to him.
Hark! The Master seeketh fellowship with thee. Open thy heart wide to His presence this hour.
Cast thy burden upon the Lord, and he shall sustain thee.
Thy load is too heavy for thee, but not for Him. Let His strength be thy support.
Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God.
Exalt His Name with thy whole heart. Praise is the atmosphere where miracles are born.
Wait on the Lord: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart.
Do not hasten before His time. Courage is found in the waiting room of the Most High.
God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
He is not far off. In thy moment of need, He is the nearest and surest Help.
In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
Include the Lord in every decision. He shall lead thee beside the still waters of His will.
Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight.
Watch thy speech and thy hidden thoughts. Let them be a sweet savour unto thy God.
Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you.
Take but one step toward Him, and thou shalt find Him rushing to meet thee in love.
Blessed is the man that trusteth in the Lord, and whose hope the Lord is.
Thy roots shall go deep by the river of life. Trusting Him is the secret to true prosperity.
He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.
Art thou at thy wit\'s end? Here is where His glory beginneth. Receive His divine energy.
The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.
Build thy life upon that which is eternal. The world passeth away, but His truth remaineth.
Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee: because he trusteth in thee.
Fix thy gaze upon Jesus. A mind anchored in Him is immune to the storms of anxiety.
For with God nothing shall be impossible.
Remove the word \'impossible\' from thy vocabulary. With thy God, all things are within reach.
Sing unto the Lord a new song; for he hath done marvellous things.
Let a new praise arise from thy lips. His wonders are fresh and His deeds are glorious.
Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.
Be persistent in thy petitions. Thy Father delighteth to open the windows of heaven for thee.
If ye love me, keep my commandments.
Obedience is the highest form of worship. Let thy love for Him be seen in thy faithfulness.
Greater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
Behold the Cross. Let the sacrificial love of Christ inspire thee to serve others today.
I am the vine, ye are the branches: He that abideth in me... bringeth forth much fruit.
Stay connected to the Source. Apart from Him, thy works are hollow; in Him, they are fruitful.
And let the peace of God rule in your hearts.
Let His peace be the umpire of thy soul. If peace be absent, seek His face until it returneth.
Preach the word; be instant in season, out of season.
Be ready to share thy hope. Thy life and thy words may be the only Bible some will ever read.
But grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord and Saviour Jesus Christ.
Never settle for thy current stature. Press on to know Him more deeply with each passing hour.
Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us, that we should be called the sons of God.
Marvel at thy new identity. Thou art a child of the King! Walk with the dignity of thy calling.
The Lord is faithful, who shall stablish you, and keep you from evil.
He is thy Guardian. Trust His faithfulness to steady thy feet and shield thee from the enemy.
The Lord bless thee, and keep thee: The Lord make his face shine upon thee.
Receive the priestly blessing. Let the light of His countenance be thy constant joy today.
For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
Remember the price that was paid. Celebrate the free gift of life that thou hast received.
He must increase, but I must decrease.
Let self fade into the background. Let the glory of Jesus be the central theme of thy life.
Stand fast therefore in the liberty wherewith Christ hath made us free.
Return not to the chains of thy past. Thou art free! Walk in the joyous liberty of the Spirit.
Watch and pray, that ye enter not into temptation.
Be vigilant. Prayer is thy radar and thy armour against the wiles of the tempter.
If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins.
Keep short accounts with God. His cleansing fountain is always open for the contrite heart.
Finally, my brethren, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of his might.
Thy strength is found in thy union with Him. Clothe thyself in His divine power this day.
For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son.
Ponder the depth of His sacrifice. Let such love compel thee to live solely for His pleasure.
Surely I come quickly. Amen. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.
Live with expectancy. Our King returneth soon. Let thy lamp be trimmed and thy heart ready.
